create_ddp_model: create a DistributedDataParallel model wrapping a torch.nn.Module for multi-process training with optional fp16 compression
default_argument_parser: build an argparse.ArgumentParser with common detectron2 CLI arguments like config-file, resume, eval-only, and num-gpus
default_setup: run basic job setup including logger configuration, environment info logging, config backup, and random seed initialization
DefaultPredictor: create a single-image end-to-end predictor that loads checkpoints, handles BGR to RGB conversion, and applies resizing
DefaultTrainer: build a default training loop with model, optimizer, data loader, LR scheduler, checkpointing, and evaluation hooks
